text: In January 1943, at the Casablanca Conference, the Allies made their choice. The target would be Sicily. The invasion was code-named Operation Husky, and it would be launched no later than July.
spoken: In January, nineteen forty-three, at the Casablanca Conference, the Allies made their choice. The target would be Sicily. The invasion was code-named Operation Husky, and it would be launched no later than July.
